Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring the department of health to develop and make available resources for pregnant women regarding prenatal nutrition.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prenatal nutrition education; and adding a newsection to chapter 43.70 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.70 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The department shall develop and make available educationalresources for pregnant women regarding prenatal nutrition bestpractices to promote infant health. The educational resources mayinclude, but are not limited to, courses delivered inperson orelectronically and pamphlets printed on paper or made available on thedepartment's web site. The educational resources are intended toprovide pregnant women knowledge of healthy foods and essential dailynutrients needed to promote infant growth and development.
